title: Burp Suite or ZAP (formerly OWASP ZAP): Web Application Testing Tools
excerpt: Burp Suite Professional is the commercial standard for web application testers; ZAP is the leading free, open-source alternative. Here is how they differ in cost, depth and ease of learning.
verdict: Burp Suite Professional is the stronger tool for professional penetration testers with a budget, thanks to the depth of its manual and automated features. ZAP is an excellent free option for beginners, developers and open-source projects, and it fits well into automated pipelines.
